Name: EQUIP_PARAM_GOODS_ST
Description: Defines goods: consumables, key items, crafting materials, spirit ashes, spells' inventory entries and other non-equipment items. Most use restrictions (multiplayer, riding, ladders, Great Rune, SpEffect states) are flags here. Many key items do nothing on their own: their effect comes from event scripts, and passive effects from merely owning an item are not defined here.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Not read by the retail game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: The Bullet or SpEffect the item triggers when used, as chosen by Reference Type. Greases and Shield Grease use this ID for the armament they normally target, and Reference ID - Left Hand for the other case. With a Replace Category set, the replace level (0–4) is added to the ID.

Fields.Name: SFX Variation ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Item weight. Retail: 0 on every named item.

Fields.Name: Basic Price
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Runes received when selling the item to a merchant. −1 (the retail default for most items): can't be sold.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Empty/Full Counterpart Item ID
Fields.Description: The other state of a refillable item: the full flask's row points to its empty row and back. When replenishing (resting), an empty item (Is Empty Refillable Item) is turned into this item. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Inventory sort order within the item's sort group.

Fields.Name: Alternate Appearance Goods ID
Fields.Description: Goods row whose icon and name are shown instead while the item's effect is active, for example a placed summon sign (Furled Fingers, Cipher Rings, Effigies) or the steed whistle while Torrent is out. Only the multiplayer items and horse whistles the game checks switch; the real item ID doesn't change. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Confirmation Dialog Message ID
Fields.Description: Dialog text for the Yes/No confirmation shown before the item is used. −1: no confirmation. Retail: 20000610 on all spirit ashes.

Fields.Name: Required SpEffect State Type
Fields.Description: The item can only be used while a SpEffect with this state type is active. 0: no requirement. Retail: only Miquella's Needle (468).

Fields.Name: Pot Group ID
Fields.Description: Links pots and aromatics to their containers. On a normal item (Goods Type 0) it's the container group the item uses: how many you can hold is the number of containers of that group you own. On a container (Goods Type 11: Cracked Pot, Ritual Pot, Perfume Bottle, Hefty Cracked Pot) it's the group that container adds to. −1: none.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon ID. Full Crimson and Cerulean flasks use the next two icon IDs as well: the base icon when the remaining charges are low, +1 at a middle fill and +2 when nearly full (thresholds from the menu's estus icon settings).

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Completion Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: achievements are awarded by event scripts.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always −1.

Fields.Name: Max Amount
Fields.Description: Maximum number you can carry. 0 or less: 99. Pots and aromatics are capped by their containers instead (see Pot Group ID).

Fields.Name: Humanity Cost
Fields.Description: Leftover from earlier games: the item can't be used unless a player counter (humanity in Dark Souls) is at least this value, and using it subtracts the value. Elden Ring has no such resource. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Over Dexterity
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Goods Type
Fields.Description: Kind of item. Sets the inventory category and switches type-specific rules: Key Items (1), Crafting Materials (2), sorceries (5), incantations (16) and containers (11) can't be used from the item slots. Pots and aromatics of type 0 are capped by their containers (11). Spirit ashes (7, 8) follow the spirit summon rules. Wondrous Physick (9) and its Crystal Tears (10) and Great Runes (15) have their own handling.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What the Reference IDs point to: 1 Bullet (thrown items, pots), 2 SpEffect (consumables, buffs). Retail rows with 0 have no reference.

Fields.Name: Attack Behavior Category
Fields.Description: Category of the attacks the item creates, used to decide which SpEffect attack modifiers apply to them (same categories as the magic and accessory fields). 0: none. Retail: 5 (unarmed and thrown items) on throwables such as Ruin Fragment.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Quick Match Use Restriction
Fields.Description: Colosseum modes in which the item can't be used; no effect outside the Colosseum. 0: no restriction; 1: Duel; 2: United Combat; 3: Combat Ordeal; 4: Duel and Combat Ordeal; 5: Duel and United Combat; 6: United Combat and Combat Ordeal; 7: every mode. Retail: 1 on Flasks of Crimson Tears and Wondrous Physick, 7 on the multiplayer fingers, effigies, Great Runes and similar items.

Fields.Name: Use Animation
Fields.Description: Animation category played when the item is used. Some values add a requirement: 12 and 24 (Rock Heart, Priestess Heart, Lamenter's Mask) need all four armor slots empty; 11 and 23 need the head slot empty.

Fields.Name: Menu Opened on Use
Fields.Description: Menu opened when the item is used (multiplayer menus, spirit summon, message writing). 0: none. Items with a menu are blocked while that menu can't be opened.

Fields.Name: Blocking SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while the player has an active SpEffect of the category this value stands for (some values cover several categories, as the option names show). 0: no limit. Retail: only row 99 (2).

Fields.Name: Replace Category
Fields.Description: Adds a replace level to the Reference ID while certain SpEffect states are active: 1 uses Replace Level 1/2 (+1/+2), 2 uses Item Replace Level 1–4 (+1 to +4). 0: none. Retail: always 0.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Usable as Host
Fields.Description: The item can be used in your own world as a normal (host) player.

Fields.Name: Usable as Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: The item can be used while in the gray (offline phantom) state.

Fields.Name: Usable as Cooperator
Fields.Description: The item can be used as a cooperating phantom (summoned or Hunter).

Fields.Name: Usable as Invader
Fields.Description: The item can be used as a hostile phantom (invader or duelist).

Fields.Name: Usable During Multiplayer
Fields.Description: The item can be used while a multiplayer session is active. When off, it's blocked during multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Online Only
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while playing offline.

Fields.Name: Can Equip to Item Slot
Fields.Description: The item can be set in the quick item and pouch slots.

Fields.Name: Consumed on Use
Fields.Description: Using the item reduces the held count by one.

Fields.Name: Auto Equip on Pickup
Fields.Description: The item is equipped to a free item slot automatically when obtained.

Fields.Name: Is Placed Object
Fields.Description: Marks items that place an object in the world. Retail: Rainbow Stone, Glowstone, Grace Mimic and Polter Stone.

Fields.Name: Is Unique
Fields.Description: Only one can be held: picking up more doesn't raise the count.

Fields.Name: Can Discard
Fields.Description: The item can be discarded from the inventory.

Fields.Name: Can Store in Chest
Fields.Description: The item can be put in the storage chest.

Fields.Name: Blocked if Target Hand Unarmed
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while the armament it targets is Unarmed (the right hand, or the left when two-handing it). Retail: greases.

Fields.Name: Removed on New Game+
Fields.Description: The item is taken away when starting the next playthrough.

Fields.Name: Is Empty Refillable Item
Fields.Description: The empty state of a refillable item: replenishing (resting) replaces it with the Empty/Full Counterpart item. Works with Replenish Type.

Fields.Name: Is Full Refillable Item
Fields.Description: The full state of a refillable item: replenishing (resting) tops its count back up. Works with Replenish Type.

Fields.Name: Is Weapon Buff
Fields.Description: Buffs the held armament (greases). The item can only be used if the target armament allows buffs (its Is Enhance flag). The right-hand armament is targeted, or the left one while two-handing it (using Reference ID - Left Hand).

Fields.Name: Is Repair Item
Fields.Description: Repair item: blocked when the target armament can't be repaired (its Disable Repair flag). Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Cannot Drop for Others
Fields.Description: A dropped copy can't be shared with other players in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Disable Use in Colosseum
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Arena restrictions come from Quick Match Use Restriction.

Fields.Name: Only Usable in Colosseum
Fields.Description: The item can only be used while the Colosseum Area SpEffect state (232) is active. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Can Cancel Use Early
Fields.Description: The use animation can be cancelled early. Retail: drawstring greases and throwing items.

Fields.Name: Apply User's SpEffect Modifiers
Fields.Description: The item's bullet gets the user's active SpEffect attack modifiers (buffs). Retail: most pots and thrown items.

Fields.Name: Shared Count Group
Fields.Description: When the count of an item in this group changes, every held item with the same value changes with it (used so all upgrade levels of a flask share charges). 0: not shared. Retail: 1 Crimson Tears, 2 Cerulean Tears.

Fields.Name: Reference ID - Left Hand
Fields.Description: Bullet or SpEffect used instead of Reference ID when the item targets the left-hand armament: greases while two-handing the left armament, and Shield Grease on the left shield. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Virtual Weapon ID
Fields.Description: Armament whose stats the item's attack uses (for example a pot's damage), and which the menu shows for it. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Bonus Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Cast
Fields.Description: SFX played while the item is being used, before it takes effect. A few multiplayer items override it while their effect is active. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Activate
Fields.Description: SFX played when the item takes effect. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Effect
Fields.Description: SFX played after the item has taken effect. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Usable with Great Rune Active
Fields.Description: The item can be used while a Great Rune is active. Off: blocked while it's active (retail: Rune Arc, the Great Runes and the Crystal Tears).

Fields.Name: Checks Region Warp Permit Graces
Fields.Description: Warp item check against the current play region's Warp Item Use Permit Bonfire IDs (PlayRegionParam): the item is blocked when that check fails. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Usable on Ladder
Fields.Description: The item can be used while on a ladder.

Fields.Name: Usable While Multiplayer Starts
Fields.Description: The item can be used while a multiplayer session is being set up (joining or waiting for the session). Off: blocked during that time.

Fields.Name: Can Use Several at Once
Fields.Description: The inventory menu allows using several at once. Retail: rune items.

Fields.Name: Is Shield Buff
Fields.Description: Buffs a shield (Shield Grease). The target armament must be able to guard. The left armament is targeted (using Reference ID - Left Hand), or the right one while two-handing it.

Fields.Name: Blocked by Warp Ban
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while the Warp Ban SpEffect state (278) is active, and when the current play region's Warp Item Prohibition event flags (PlayRegionParam) forbid it. Retail: Pureblood Knight's Medal.

Fields.Name: Only Usable with Disconnect Penalty
Fields.Description: The item can only be used while a multiplayer disconnect penalty is in effect. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Replenish Type
Fields.Description: Which refill the item belongs to when replenishing (resting): 1 Crimson Tears, 2 Cerulean Tears, 3 Wondrous Physick. 0: not refilled. Works with the empty/full refillable flags.

Fields.Name: Auto Replenish Type
Fields.Description: Group used by automatic replenishment of carried items from storage. 0: none. Retail: 1 on runes and materials, 2 on consumables.

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: The item can be dropped on the ground.

Fields.Name: Show in Acquisition Log
Fields.Description: The item appears in the item acquisition log when obtained. Retail: on, except 6 hidden rows such as 9006 Warm Welcome.

Fields.Name: Is Horse Summon
Fields.Description: Summons the horse. Blocked where the horse can't be summoned, and while the horse is dead extra conditions apply (reviving it). Its menu appearance changes while the horse is out (see Alternate Appearance Goods ID).

Fields.Name: Acquisition Dialog Condition
Fields.Description: Controls the pop-up shown when the item is obtained. Retail: 2 on almost every item, 0 on the same hidden rows that skip the log.

Fields.Name: Is Sleep Collection Item
Fields.Description: Leftover collection-item flag: the game can check whether such items are held, and blocks their use unless a related game state is active. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The item can be used while mounted. Off: blocked while mounted.

Fields.Name: Only Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while not mounted. Retail: the Rowa Raisin horse feed items.

Fields.Name: Max Number in Storage
Fields.Description: Maximum number the storage chest can hold. 0 or less: 99.

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Sort group: items with the same group are listed together when sorting by item type. 255: none.

Fields.Name: Usable in No-Attack Areas
Fields.Description: The item can be used while the No-Attack Area SpEffect state (457) is active (for example at the Roundtable Hold). Off: blocked there.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Cannot Be Obtained
Fields.Description: The item can't be obtained, and copies already held are removed by the inventory check. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Restore Count After Quick Match
Fields.Description: The held count is saved when a quick match starts and restored afterwards.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Price-like value checked by a shop menu: −1 excludes the item from that menu's list. Retail: 0 on every named item; other values only on unnamed test rows.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Item rarity, shown in menus and in the pop-up when the item is obtained.

Fields.Name: Requires Spirit Summon Area
Fields.Description: 1: the item can only be used where spirit ashes can be summoned (near a Rebirth Monument). Retail: 1 on all spirit ashes.

Fields.Name: Blocking SpEffect State Type
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while a SpEffect with this state type is active. 0: no limit. Retail: the steed whistle (433), Memory of Grace (465) and the transformation items (477–479).

Fields.Name: AI Usage Judgment ID
Fields.Description: ID the NPC AI uses to decide when to use this item. −1: none.

Fields.Name: FP Cost
Fields.Description: FP spent when using the item, multiplied by the user's SpEffect FP cost modifiers. The item can't be used without enough FP. Spirit ashes skip the cost in some summon states.

Fields.Name: HP Cost
Fields.Description: HP spent when using the item. The item can't be used unless current HP is higher than the cost. −1: none. Spirit ashes skip the cost in some summon states.

Fields.Name: Upgraded Goods ID
Fields.Description: The goods row this item becomes when upgraded (spirit ash upgrades). −1: can't be upgraded.

Fields.Name: Upgrade Material Set ID
Fields.Description: Materials needed for the upgrade (EquipMtrlSetParam). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Upgrade Cost
Fields.Description: Runes needed for the upgrade.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 0
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 0, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it. Elden Ring has no covenants. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Required Character Level
Fields.Description: Minimum character level needed to use the item. Spirit ashes skip it in some summon states. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Item Get Tutorial Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag set ON when the item is obtained, used to trigger a tutorial. 0 or −1: none.
